rule.clearSpace: Clear space: 30 px on each side, at every reproduction size.
rule.minimum: Minimum size: 80 px wide, below that clarity is lost.
rule.noRecolor: Never recolor: black on white or white on jet/obsidian only.
rule.noEffects: No effects, shadows, rotation or distortion.
rule.noRedraw: Never redraw the wordmark; the asset kit file replaces the path in brand-mark.tsx.
